notes.title: Pre Release Update
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
- Changing Zones scaling toned down
- Monsters Now get stronger over time.
- New Divine Relics Added
- Drop rate improved for relics
- relics balance changes across the board
- new Higher shrine Added with better drop
- new Elemental bosses added

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Controller support fixed (multiple players can now join with different controllers)

notes.title: Patch notes: Arena, Achievments, Difficulty Meter, and More.
notes.notes:
Added Achievements that gives you shards and divine relics on completions.
Added Difficuilty meter that scales enemies for more difficult gameplay (will later add quests and rewards connected to this meter.)
Elite monsters now appear on the minimap.
monsters now rarely get stuck in walls.
Arena now available.
Font changed.
UI minor improvements.

notes.notes:
